description:
This adds the `rom_pick_ab_update_partition` function taken from #1969, without the wi-fi firmware partition support from that PR (which doesn't compile with Risc-V).

I think this function has more uses beyond the wi-fi firmware partition support (eg in the encrypted bootloader example), so would like to get it merged.

comments.body: lets make these (and the ones below) `#if HAS_REDUNDANCY_COPROCESSOR`
This one needs to be defined for Risc-V too, so I've left it as `#if PICO_RP2350` - I've made the one below `#if HAS_REDUNDANCY_COPROCESSOR` as that is still Arm only

It seems weird that line 18 claims "(this header is RP2350 only)" but line 25 claims "(this header is Arm-only)" :confused: 
Perhaps "these defines" or "this section" or "this code" or similar?
I'm sure this is probably a stupid question with a simple answer, but why does line 10 do `#if !PICO_RP2040` whilst line 116 does `#if PICO_RP2350` ?
ok, makes sense. it was a `PICO_RP2350` check before, but lets make this a `#if !PICO_RP2040`
